description: This file defines the Container interface for OFBiz, specifying lifecycle methods such as init, start, stop, and getName for container components.

classes.name: Container
classes.description: An interface representing a container with lifecycle methods for initialization, starting, stopping, and retrieving the container's name.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with command-line arguments, a unique name, and configuration file (currently always null).

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the container process in a non-blocking manner, returning true if successful.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the container process in a non-blocking manner.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container instance.
